new_findings.title: Navigation/section links are emitted as material candidates and can consume the item budget ahead of real documents
new_findings.evidence:
CN nav
公告业绩
-> 2 candidates (base 0). max_items=1 with nav '公告' before '2025年年度报告' -> only nav emitted + item_limit_reached, real report lost; base emitted the report. Default max_items=30 with 'Annual Reports' nav + 30 report PDFs -> nav + 29 reports, item_limit_reached; base 30 reports. header Results/Annual Reports and footer Reports also admitted; Results/News Releases are new vs base. Nav candidates inject publication_date_unknown/partial even when every real document is dated.
new_findings.required_fix: Do not treat nav/header/footer section anchors (generic section labels, no document suffix) as candidate material; skip or demote to deferred index_notice. At minimum rank document-suffix links ahead of non-suffix material links within max_items. Add EN + CN regression tests with a nav link before a real report at max_items=1 and at the default bound.

new_findings.title: Single-link page-level <time> is still adopted as a material date and can exclude the only material

new_findings.title: unclassified_document_links is emitted for deliberate legal/navigation vetoes, producing false partial coverage
new_findings.evidence: Privacy Statement PDF -> limitations [unclassified_document_links], partial; Annual Report + privacy PDF -> 1 candidate + same limitation; sealed-derived fixture -> limitations [dynamic_content_unresolved, unclassified_document_links]. By construction any doc-suffix link without a legal/page/nav token is admitted, so this limitation only fires for intentional legal/nav exclusions; ordinary IR pages with a privacy PDF become partial for a non-coverage reason.
new_findings.required_fix: Separate an intentional legal/nav exclusion (excluded_legal_document_links or no limitation) from a genuinely unclassified document link; keep 'no silent clean index' for the latter.

new_findings.title: Legal page-section veto still over-vetoes titles with a strong material clue
new_findings.evidence: 'Annual Report 2025 - Legal Entity Changes' (/ar.pdf) -> 0 candidates + unclassified_document_links; base 1 candidate. '2026 Annual Report - Accessibility Statement' -> 0. _LEGAL_PAGE_TITLE_TOKENS runs before the material-clue path, contrary to IR-03's 'do not let a single secondary token veto a strong material title' requirement; the delivery says 'correctly excludes' without the bounded-heuristic caveat.
new_findings.required_fix: Use structural legal/nav signals for page-section vetoes or let a strong material clue win when the URL is a document; otherwise record as a bounded heuristic in the delivery.

new_findings.title: Item-title recovery can promote a 300-character prose blob to the title

new_findings.required_fix: Prefer a heading/cell label or cap the recovered title (e.g. 120 chars) and require item-like block text; add a regression test.

new_findings.title: Deferred item truncation removes max_items as a work bound; per-candidate whole-page SHA-256 makes large indexes O(items x page_bytes)
new_findings.evidence: max_items=30, N material anchors: N=1000 0.10s vs base 0.02s; N=5000 0.99s vs 0.09s; N=10000 4.79s vs 0.65s. Profile: 10,001 sha256 calls / 0.62s for 5000 anchors (index_source_sha256 = sha256(original) per pending record); base stops after 30 candidates. A byte-capped 8 MiB page with many anchor rows can spend minutes and hold a large pending list while returning only 30 items.
new_findings.required_fix: Cache the page hash once per page and cap pending collection (max_items + bounded notice allowance, recording item_limit_reached).
